Build.description: General-purpose assistant for coding and non-coding tasks.

new-branch-and-commit.template:
Create a new git branch and commit the current changes.

Inputs:
- Branch name: $1 (if empty, propose one and ask me to confirm)
- Commit message: $2 (if empty, propose one and ask me to confirm)

Workflow:
1) Run git status and summarize changes.
2) Create/switch to the branch (prefer: git switch -c).
3) Stage changes (default: git add -A) and show staged diff stat.
4) Commit with the confirmed message.

Safety:
- Never commit secrets; stop and ask.

commit-and-push.template:
Commit the current changes and push the current branch to the remote.

Inputs:
- Commit message: $1 (if empty, propose one and ask me to confirm)

Workflow:
1) Run git status and summarize changes.
2) Confirm current branch is not main/master.
3) Stage changes (default: git add -A) and show staged diff stat.
4) Commit with the confirmed message.
5) Push with upstream if needed (prefer: git push -u origin HEAD).

Safety:
- Never commit secrets; stop and ask.
- Never push directly to main/master.

pr-comments.template:
Pull and summarize PR comments for the GitHub PR associated with the current git branch.

Prefer using the `pr-comments` skill (read-only).

Inputs:
- Mode: $1 (optional: summary|raw-json; default: summary)

Workflow:
1) Resolve the PR for the current branch (prefer: `gh pr view --json number,url,title,headRefName,baseRefName`).
2) Fetch comment data (conversation comments, reviews, inline review comments) using `gh api ... --paginate`.
3) Output a grouped summary, or raw JSON if mode is `raw-json`.

Safety:
- Read-only; do not post/edit/delete comments.
- If no PR is found, report that clearly.
pr-comments.description: Pull PR comments for current branch
